title: Ollama is unavailable
help: Open Ollama or run ollama serve. Nila connects only to a local loopback address. Check that Ollama is running before chatting or switching models.

title: Selected model is not installed
help: Select the profile again to download and load the missing model, or run ollama pull MODEL_NAME. Already-installed models are reused. Check the model name if downloading fails.

title: Another generation or model change is running
help: Wait for the current request or stop the answer/Learning Lab. A crashed generation lease expires after 12 minutes. Keep the active download window open.

title: Generation, download or model load interrupted
help: Check Ollama and available memory; try Fast or a shorter prompt. Downloads also need internet. If model activation fails, the previous selection remains saved.

title: Ollama address is not local
help: Unset NILA_OLLAMA_URL or use http://127.0.0.1:11434. Nila intentionally refuses remote model endpoints for ordinary local chat.

title: Internal request error
help: Restart Nila and reproduce with a non-private test message. Report the version and steps on GitHub; remove tokens, private file contents and personal data from logs.

title: Encryption key unavailable
help: Restore the original vault.key with its matching database. Do not delete/reset the database. Windows-protected keys are tied to the original Windows account.

title: No web evidence or search timeout
help: Check internet and retry, or turn search Off. Public search providers may throttle requests. Nila does not invent a live answer when retrieval fails.

title: Installation or update integrity problem
help: Read the message after the code to distinguish this from web search. Inspect last-update.log in NilaApp. Retry the official installer, preserving your separate personal-data directory.

title: Windows Application Control blocked the executable
help: An unsigned binary may be blocked by a Windows trust policy. Ask the authorized policy administrator to review it. Nila does not disable security, add exclusions or skip executable checks.

title: Local speech language pack is unavailable
help: Choose a supported language in the microphone panel. English locales can fall back to en-US. Nila downloads a browser pack only when needed. On Windows, try Use Windows microphone with an installed Windows speech recognition pack. Allow microphone access; cloud recognition is never silently enabled.

title: Read aloud has no voice or will not play
help: Install a local speech voice for the answer language in Windows Settings. Wait for voices to load and retry. Read aloud changes to Stop while playing; click the same button to stop.

title: An attached file is missing from the answer
help: Wait until upload finishes and its filename appears before sending. Text/PDF attachments remain linked to the chat and appear on the sent message. File-only send summarizes the attachment. Image files and scanned PDFs are not supported; convert to text first. Attached-file requests use local context, not automatic web search.

title: Nila logo is missing or broken
help: Update to v0.8.0 or newer, close all old Nila Web processes and reopen nila web. Hard-refresh the browser. Source builds require npm ci and npm run build in web. The app must serve /nila-logo.png as an image.

title: No learned or remembered entries
help: Open Memory to see separate personal, pending, learned and web counts. Approve pending personal facts. Only accepted Learning Lab reviews are saved. Check the knowledge switch and Lab status; this is reference retrieval, not training model weights.

title: Another installation/update is running
help: Let the current update finish. If an interrupted updater remains stuck, save work and restart Windows. Do not run parallel installers or delete the lock file; its presence alone does not hold the OS lock.

title: The bot is not replying or changing models
help: Start your bot, configure its token and positive private user ID, and keep Nila/Ollama running. Use /model fast, medium or current. Downloads need internet. Groups are ignored; stop duplicate polling processes or webhooks.

title: nila is not recognized
help: Open a new terminal after installing. Check that %LOCALAPPDATA%\NilaApp\bin is on your user PATH. Use nila version to check the installed application.
